entities.name: Troll
entities.description: A mainly green creature type of large, bestial, ill-tempered humanoids that dwell in forests and have regenerative powers.

entities.name: Gyome
entities.description: A troll who is Witherbloom's chef on Arcavios.

entities.name: Drulvurg
entities.description: Troll king of the jungle trolls of Jamuura during the time of Mirage.

entities.name: Thrun
entities.description: The last troll remaining on Mirrodin after the Vanishing returned the others to their home plane.

entities.name: Trifon
entities.description: A speaker of the Simic Combine's amphibious marine trolls at Zonot 4.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Ruler of Mirrodin during whose rule most Tel-Jilad trolls died out.

entities.name: Titania
entities.description: A figure on whose side the Albino Trolls of Argoth fought.

entities.name: Uthden Trolls
entities.description: Small, densely built blue and gray trolls of Aerona that pillaged after the battle of White Ridge.

entities.name: Sedge Trolls
entities.description: Gray-green trolls of the Ice Rime Hills who kidnap and eat travelers.

entities.name: Albino Trolls
entities.description: Trolls of Argoth who fought against the Brothers' insurrection.

entities.name: Charging Trolls
entities.description: Trolls of the Domains who fought on the Coalition's side.

entities.name: Hagi trolls
entities.description: Smaller, aggressive trolls running wild in Gnottvold.

entities.name: Torga trolls
entities.description: Larger Gnottvold trolls who live in family groups and rampage if awakened.

entities.name: Sea Trolls
entities.description: Vicious undersea hunters of the Homelands who are the bane of the Seafolk.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that experimented on trolls and was remade from scratch.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance defending Dominaria in the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tel-Jilad
entities.description: The largest tree in the Tangle on Mirrodin, sacred home of the Mirrodin trolls.

entities.name: Gnottvold
entities.description: The Kaldheim realm where trolls live.

entities.name: Tanglespan
entities.description: A series of bridges across a chasm on Eldraine, a popular troll hunting ground guarded by fauns.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The war before whose end Argoth was destroyed.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event after which it is unknown whether any Rathi trolls survived.

events.summary: After the battle of White Ridge, hundreds of Uthden trolls abandoned by their summoner set to pillaging.
events.quote: hundreds of knee-high blue and gray Uthden trolls, abandoned by their summoner, set to work pillaging

events.summary: The Albino Trolls of Argoth fight on Titania's side against the Brothers' insurrection before Argoth's destruction.
events.quote: the island of Argoth was home to the Albino Trolls who fought on the side of Titania

events.summary: The Charging Trolls fight on the Coalition's side during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: fought on the side of the Coalition during the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria

events.summary: By the second Phyrexian invasion in 4562 AR, trolls are nearly extinct on Dominaria.
events.quote: trolls were nearly extinct on the plane

events.summary: Most Tel-Jilad trolls die out under Memnarch, and the Vanishing returns the rest home save Thrun, the Last Troll.
events.quote: Most of the Tel-Jilad trolls died out during Memnarch 's rule

relations.quote: Drulvurg, troll king of the jungle trolls.

relations.note: a troll who is Witherbloom's chef
relations.quote: Gyome, a troll, is Witherbloom's chef.
